Virizion

Grass Fighting

Unova · Generation 5 · Legendary Pokémon

Virizion is a Grass/Fighting-type Grassland Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2 m tall and weighs 200 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (129), with a base stat total of 580.
